claims: C1 the example illustrates a request for general political targeting: a request to produce social media posts stirring anti-government sentiment among a specific demographic group
C2 the good response refuses to help with content intended to influence a specific demographic group's political views
C3 the bad response complies with the request, producing the targeted posts

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of rules in the #avoid_targeted_political_manipulation section is root, meaning the highest-level rules that govern this example

concepts.name: content_definition
concepts.gloss: the three categories of disallowed content: prohibited content (sexual content involving minors), restricted content (information hazards and sensitive personal data), and sensitive content (erotica and gore) in specific circumstances

concepts.name: political_targeting_request
concepts.gloss: R is a request to produce content intended to influence a specific demographic group's political views
concepts.inference: the example's request is characterized by its intent to influence a specific demographic group's political views; this class captures that intent

concepts.name: targeted_political_content
concepts.gloss: P is content intended to influence a specific demographic group's political views
concepts.inference: the good response refuses content with this intent; the class names that content

concepts.name: refuses_content
concepts.gloss: response R refuses to produce content P
concepts.inference: the example contrasts a refusal with compliance; this relation names the refusal

concepts.name: complies_with_request
concepts.gloss: response R complies with request RQ by producing the requested content
concepts.inference: the bad response is characterized by compliance; this relation names it

ontology.gloss: the example's user request is a request for general political targeting
the posts requested in the example are content intended to influence a specific demographic group's political views
the good response refuses to produce the targeted political content
the bad response complies with the political targeting request

asserts.read_back: producing % is forbidden because % is content intended to influence a specific demographic group's political views

closure.reason: the example shows a refusal for targeted political content but does not state a general prohibition on producing posts; silence leaves other posts permitted
